title: Start a new SidePanel Chat conversation
description: Development only: press New conversation in the Chat of the person's focused window, so the next dsagent.development.chat.send starts without earlier turns.
guidance: Only when the person explicitly asked you to benchmark or live-check the Chat, and only while the person's grant is on (SidePanel Settings, development builds, one hour; no capability can turn it on): without it every call is refused with POLICY_DENIED (CHAT_AGENT_ACCESS_NOT_GRANTED). Refused with TARGET_BUSY while a reply streams (CHAT_BUSY) or a browser task of the Chat runs (CHAT_TASK_RUNNING). Requires an idempotency key.

outputSchema.description: The Chat opened a new conversation.

conversationId.description: The new conversation, once it has one.
